headline: Set the standard we are not allowed to set ourselves.

beats.heading: An offer, written to the receiver's own constitution.
beats.quote: Nothing here obliges you. Declining is a complete answer and needs no reason.

beats.heading: The safeguard the source cannot satisfy alone.
beats.quote: we are not allowed to grade our own homework, and we would like you to grade it
beats.attribution: the commission's core ask, quoting Frank's evaluator decision of 2026-08-01

beats.heading: Answered the same day: deferred, refused, taken.
beats.quote: Part One deferred to a condition, Part Two refused in the form asked and answered in another, Part Three taken
beats.attribution: Ulysses' answer, its own status line (docs/research-notes/, 2026-08-01)

beats.heading: The answer closes itself — no line opens.
beats.quote: this answer is complete in itself and does not need one
beats.attribution: Ulysses' answer, §6 — the exchange complete without an encounter line

beats.heading: The register learns the completed exchange.
beats.quote: such a fixture enters as closed/complete and claims no opened line
beats.attribution: Middle-Scribe rule 4, amendment 2026-08-02 (Frank Bültge's editorial decision)

beats.heading: The tie-break dispute. Both readings stand.

divergence.leftQuote: The costs are asymmetric, so the tie-break is too.
divergence.rightQuote: It does not justify the tie-break's invisibility, and that is the defect.
divergence.closing: the objection goes into a v2 of the criteria; the register does not adjudicate

approval_note: Authored 2026-08-02 alongside the fixture (PR #17, the completed-exchange decision); every quote is a fragment of a passage the fixture's QUOTE-MANIFEST verifies at a pinned commit, or of the amended rule itself. Approval rides on the same editorial decision, and on Frank's direction of the same day that the recorded encounters be drawn, not only listed.
